Log in to the BrickKit Market.

What it does:
  1. Asks for the user name in the terminal
  2. Asks for the password in the terminal (input hidden)
  3. Calls the Market API to verify the credentials
  4. On success writes the token to .brickkit/credentials (permissions 0600)

The Market address is taken from the install source of type market in brickkit.yaml; if several are configured, choose with --market.

Token priority: .brickkit/credentials > sources.authToken in brickkit.yaml.
Before each use of a token the CLI checks expiresAt; when expired it asks you to log in again (there is no automatic refresh).

Usage:
  brickkit login [flags]

Examples:
  brickkit login
  brickkit login --market https://market.example.com/api/v1
  echo "$PASSWORD" | brickkit login --username ci-bot --password-stdin

Flags:
  -h, --help              help for login
      --market string     Market address (defaults to the market install source in brickkit.yaml)
      --password-stdin    Read the password from standard input (for CI; not echoed and not kept in history)
      --username string   User name (asked interactively if not given)

Global Flags:
      --log-level string   Level of the JSON logs on stderr (debug | info | warn | error | off) (default "off")
